newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Investment plans two $100 mln offshore funds.
newsitem.headline: Korea Investment plans two $100 mln offshore funds.

text.p: Korea Investment Trust Co plans to set up a $100 million offshore fund for investment in local stocks and another $100 million fund for bond investment, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.
The spokesman said Korea Investment has filed for approval with the finance ministry. Details of the plan would be announced later.
Offshore funds are set up through sales of beneficiary certificates to foreign investors.
The finance ministry said late last month it would allow domestic investment firms to expand issuances of beneficiary certificates abroad for investment in local stocks and bonds.
The ministry has also said it would encourage investment firms to submit issue plans by the end of February.
